s.en: show / manipulate ETS (Enhanced Transmission Selection) settings of the DCB (Data Center Bridging) subsystem

syn: dcb [ OPTIONS ] ets { COMMAND | help } ⏎ dcb ets show dev DEV [ willing ] [ ets-cap ] [ cbs ] [ tc-tsa ] [ reco-tc-tsa ] [ pg-bw ] [ tc-bw ] [ reco-tc-bw ] [ prio-tc ] [ reco-prio-tc ] ⏎ dcb ets set dev DEV [ willing { on | off } ] [ { tc-tsa | reco-tc-tsa } TSA-MAP ] [ { pg-bw | tc-bw | reco-tc-bw } BW-MAP ] [ { prio-tc | reco-prio-tc } PRIO-MAP ] ⏎ TSA-MAP := [ TSA-MAP ] TSA-MAPPING ⏎ TSA-MAPPING := { TC | all }:{ strict | cbs | ets | vendor } ⏎ BW-MAP := [ BW-MAP ] BW-MAPPING
